falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes below 4,150 on any single day within the next 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A break below the August 2024 low would invalidate the 80% pattern match to bottom_2024_aug, as that bottom held at 4,155; this would signal the current structure is not replicating that reversal and likely breaking down into a lower low

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 35 for two consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The August 2024 bottom saw VIX peak at 38.5 but rapidly compress; sustained VIX above 35 indicates panic is not being absorbed, contradicting the bottoming pattern and suggesting a blowoff phase or deeper liquidation rather than accumulation

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y Treasury yield drops below 3.80% while S&P 500 is simultaneously below 4,300
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: This would signal a flight-to-safety recession panic rather than a growth-scare bottom; in August 2024, yields fell with equities initially but stabilized as stocks bounced—concurrent collapse in both indicates macro deterioration beyond the pattern's parameters
